title: How is Christopher Columbus connected to Baby Yoda?
description:
A painting, five centuries of Spanish monarchs and four real photos connect Christopher Columbus to Baby Yoda.

Christopher Columbus → Isabella I → King Juan Carlos → Ronald Reagan → Sigourney Weaver → Jon Favreau → Baby Yoda

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Christopher Columbus → Queen Isabella: In 1843, an American artist painted Columbus pleading with Queen Isabella of Spain to fund his voyage.
   Photo by Emanuel Leutze, No restrictions: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Emanuel_Leutze_(American,_1816-1868)._Columbus_before_the_Queen,_1843.jpg
2. Queen Isabella → King Juan Carlos (8 portraits, every holder): Isabella's crown passed down five centuries of Spanish monarchs to King Juan Carlos in 1975.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:IsabellaofCastile03.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_Charles_V,_Holy_Roman_Emperor,_seated_(1500%E2%80%931558),_formerly_attributed_to_Titian_(Alte_Pinakothek,_Munich).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Portrait_of_Philip_II_of_Spain_by_Sofonisba_Anguissola_-_002b.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Philip_IV_of_Spain_-_Vel%C3%A1zquez_1644.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Philip_V_of_Spain.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Charles_III_of_Spain_high_resolution.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Isabel_de_Borb%C3%B3n_y_Borb%C3%B3n-Dos_Sicilias.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rey_Juan_Carlos_2013.jpg
3. King Juan Carlos → Ronald Reagan: In 1981, Ronald Reagan welcomed King Juan Carlos to the White House for a state dinner.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Reagan_and_Mrs._Reagan_greet_King_Juan_Carlos_I_and_Queen_Sophia_of_Spain_1981.jpg
4. Ronald Reagan → Sigourney Weaver: In 1985, Reagan hosted Alien star Sigourney Weaver at another White House state dinner.
   Photo by Mary Anne Fackelman, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reagan_Contact_Sheet_C27275_(cropped).jpg
5. Sigourney Weaver → Jon Favreau: In 2026, Weaver joined director Jon Favreau in Paris to present The Mandalorian and Grogu.
   Photo by ManoSolo13241324, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jon_Favreau,_Sigourney_Weaver_et_Pedro_Pascal_2026.jpg
6. Jon Favreau → Baby Yoda: Jon Favreau created Baby Yoda.
   Photo by Jesse Grant/Getty Images for Disney, CC BY-SA 2.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jon_Favreau_2016.jpeg + https://www.wpxi.com/news/trending/photos-pedro-pascal/YR6N2UCEGVHLFKDUIFLG4JKRUQ/

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#christophercolumbus #babyyoda #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
